subject: Post-demo follow-up: purchase path, SOC 2/DPA review, and security questionnaire
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healthcore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: purchase path, SOC 2/DPA review, and security questionnaire

Hi Samir — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:  

Summary from call:
- HealthCore liked the latency/throughput profile for your streaming use case.
- Main gating items for procurement: SOC 2 evidence, signed DPA, and the security questionnaire that your infosec sends.
- Procurement team is deciding whether to process via corporate card, standard PO (Net 30), or buy through Azure Marketplace (you said you were evaluating marketplace billing).

Action items / next steps:
1) We attached our latest SOC 2 report and a DPA template (Redwood_DPA_Template_v3.docx) for your legal team to review. If you prefer, we can send DPA via DocuSign for faster signature.
2) Please confirm which payment path you prefer (card vs PO vs marketplace). If PO, we'll need a billing contact and PO instructions (billing address, remit-to, tax ID).
3) I attached the security questionnaire stub you mentioned — once your team sends it back we’ll have our security team fill in any required evidence.
4) Karthik will send a short commercial summary (pricing bands and commitment options) once we have the preferred payment route.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2024.pdf, Redwood_DPA_Template_v3.docx, SOW-HealthCore-v1.pdf

Proposed quick follow-up: 30-minute sync next Tuesday (8/17) to lock the procurement path and timeline. Are you available?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Samir Patel <samir@healthcore.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@healthcore.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: purchase path, SOC 2/DPA review, and security questionnaire

Thanks Jordan — solid recap. A couple quick clarifications from procurement and infosec:  

Procurement:
- We generally prefer PO for deals over $10k/month (Net 30). Marketplace is attractive because it shortens procurement time, but we need to confirm whether all required entitlements (SAML, private endpoint) are supported via the marketplace offer.
- Can you confirm if Redwood supports marketplace billing for private deployments or only hosted API? If marketplace would work for our architecture it may be the fastest route.

Security/Legal:
- I attached our standard security questionnaire (HealthCore_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). Can someone on your security team fill in the technical sections and return? There are some follow-ups around data residency and retention that our InfoSec flagged.
- We will need SOC 2 evidence and confirmation of your DPA terms; we'll share comments if the DPA requires edits.

We are aiming to get internal approval and issue a PO before end of month (8/31) if possible. We are available for the proposed sync on Tue 8/17 at 10am PT.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
HealthCore
samir@healthcore.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
Attachment: HealthCore_Security_Questionnaire.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healthcore.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: purchase path, SOC 2/DPA review, and security questionnaire

Hi Samir — Laura from Commercial Ops / Legal here. Quick answers to the procurement/security questions:  

Marketplace vs PO:
- We can offer HealthCore through Azure Marketplace for hosted API SKUs today; private/VPC deployments typically require a contract and PO because of network setup and onboarding. If your priority is fastest procurement and you are OK with hosted API for initial rollout, marketplace is the shortest path.
- If you need private deployment from day one, PO + signed DPA is the standard. We support Net 30 PO terms for enterprise deals; payment instructions we will provide once purchase route is confirmed.

SOC 2 / DPA / Questionnaire:
- SOC 2 report attached in Jordan's previous email; our security team will complete the technical fields in your questionnaire and return a redlined copy by EOD 8/16.
- If you want to speed signature, we can send the DPA and SOW via DocuSign. Here is an embedded envelope we can use (DocuSign link): https://www.docusign.com/en/embedded-sign?envelopeId=abc123def456

Next steps I propose:
1) Jordan: confirm whether HealthCore intends to start on hosted API (marketplace OK) or requires private/VPC.
2) Samir: share procurement contact and billing instructions if PO is the preferred path.
3) Laura/Karthik: we will return the filled questionnaire and a clean DPA/SOW via DocuSign for signature.

Happy to hop on Tue 8/17 10am PT. We'll send a calendar invite.

Best — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0220
From: Samir Patel <samir@healthcore.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: purchase path, SOC 2/DPA review, and security questionnaire

Laura / Jordan — thank you. Quick update from our side after internal alignment:  

- Procurement confirmed PO (Net 30) is the preferred route for the initial contract and on-prem/provisioning work. We will not use marketplace for the private deployment.
- Billing contact: Patricia Gomez (patricia.gomez@healthcore.com). She will issue the PO; Patricia asked for billing address, Redwood tax ID, and a copy of the final SOW bundled with the DPA.
- Infosec is expecting the completed questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence; thanks in advance for returning the filled copy.

Can you send a DocuSign envelope with the DPA + SOW and a separate invoice/template for PO reference? If we receive those today we can aim to route the PO next week.

Thanks — looking forward to the calendar invite for 8/17.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
HealthCore
Attachment (incoming): HealthCore_PO_Instructions.docx (will be sent by Patricia once she confirms)
